lines.text: I ran out of steam around noon.

data.define: To become too tired to continue.

example.text: I ran out of steam around noon.

misuse.text: Don't say 'run out of steam' about a kettle.

publish.title: What does "run out of steam" mean?
publish.value: Run out of steam = Lose all your energy. Example: "I ran out of steam around noon." (casual English).
